tagline: I am an Innovator ... I belong to Innovators World
prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Premium square ecommerce studio photograph on warm ivory background of two physical Innovators World garments, complete silhouettes in frame. LEFT: chalk-white cotton T-shirt with elegant navy-and-gold typographic chest print. RIGHT: midnight navy pullover hoodie with a warm-gold and white typographic chest print, double-layer hood and kangaroo pocket. BOTH garments carry the exact same text, preserving case and punctuation, split into intentional readable lines: 'I am an Innovator ...' and 'I belong to Innovators World'. Make 'Innovator' the large focal word. Small gold globe-inside-lightbulb emblem above or below the statement. No faces, people, character portraits, extra slogans or watermarks. Refined contemporary collegiate/editorial typography, real cotton fabric weave, seams and subtle folds, soft studio lighting, generous product margins. This is a new community belonging merchandise series coordinated with the navy teal gold Innovators World gear range.
